articles.title: The Halo Remake Just Proved That Any Future Adaptation Needs to Break the Rules
articles.summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a stunning remake that feels definitive—so much so that it exposes the flaw in direct game-to-screen adaptations. The failed Paramount+ series at least tried originality; future projects must follow Fallout's lead and tell new stories in the Halo universe.

articles.title: Fuerza Regida Conquers New York With 50 Cent, J Balvin, and a Thunderstorm
articles.summary: Fuerza Regida closed their first U.S. stadium tour at Citi Field with a genre-blending spectacle. Despite a heavy thunderstorm, the San Bernardino band brought out 50 Cent, Bobby Shmurda, and J Balvin, fusing corridos bélicos with hip-hop and cementing their place in New York's music scene.

articles.title: How a Discontinued Drum Machine Became Hip-Hop's Secret Weapon
articles.summary: The Roland TR-808, sold only from 1980 to 1982, became foundational to hip-hop. Its booming kicks and crisp snares define classics from 'Planet Rock' to Kanye's 808s & Heartbreak. On 808 Day, we trace its legacy through 13 essential tracks.
